18 Hours on a Local Bus in Madagascar! Experience the real African countryside as we travel from Antananarivo to Morondava on one of our longest road journeys in Africa.
In this episode of Travelling Mantra, we begin our adventure at a local bus station in Antananarivo, the capital of Madagascar. Our destination is Morondava, a fascinating town on Madagascar's western coast.
What was expected to be a 15–16 hour journey eventually took around 18 hours!
